translations.definition: adv. 專業地、內行地、以職業水準地

examples.en: The consultant handled the negotiation professionally, calming tensions between two long-standing clients.

translations.zh-TW: 顧問以專業的態度處理這場談判，緩和了兩家長期合作客戶之間的緊張關係。

examples.en: Dress professionally for tomorrow's quarterly review; several board members will be watching via video link.

translations.zh-TW: 明天季報檢討會請穿著專業得體，幾位董事將透過視訊觀看。

examples.en: Although the firm is small, its technicians are trained professionally and meet ISO quality standards.

translations.zh-TW: 儘管公司規模不大，其技術人員都受過專業訓練，並符合 ISO 品質標準。

translations.definition: v. 宣傳、公開報導、推廣

examples.en: The in-house marketing team publicized the new line of eco-packaged products across three social platforms.

translations.zh-TW: 內部行銷團隊在三個社群平台上宣傳了新的環保包裝產品線。

examples.en: Our PR department is publicizing the charity gala to attract sponsors from the luxury retail sector.

translations.zh-TW: 公關部門正在宣傳這場慈善晚會，以吸引精品零售業的贊助商。

examples.en: A start-up that publicizes its data-handling policies openly tends to gain consumer trust faster than rivals.

translations.zh-TW: 公開宣傳自身資料處理政策的新創公司，通常會比競爭對手更快贏得消費者信任。

translations.definition: n. 光線、射線、一線（希望等）

examples.en: A single ray of morning sun slipped through the office blinds and warmed the keyboard.

translations.zh-TW: 早晨一線陽光穿過辦公室百葉窗，照暖了鍵盤。

examples.en: The clinic upgraded its X-ray equipment so that diagnostic rays expose patients to less radiation.

translations.zh-TW: 診所升級了 X 光設備，使診斷射線對病人的輻射暴露更低。

examples.en: After three quarters of flat sales, the new contract was a ray of hope for the struggling branch.

translations.zh-TW: 在連三季業績持平之後，這份新合約成了苦苦支撐的分公司的一線希望。

translations.definition: v. 重新裝潢、重新粉刷佈置

examples.en: The hotel chain redecorated all 120 suites before the peak summer season.

translations.zh-TW: 連鎖飯店在夏季旺季前，將全部 120 間套房重新裝潢了一遍。

examples.en: Facilities staff are redecorating the lobby this weekend, so visitors may use the side entrance.

translations.zh-TW: 設施人員本週末正在重新裝潢大廳，訪客請改走側門。

examples.en: A landlord who redecorates between tenants usually commands a higher monthly rent.

translations.zh-TW: 房東若在租客更迭之間重新裝潢，通常能要求更高的月租。

examples.en: The coastal refinery processes crude oil shipped in from three offshore platforms.

translations.zh-TW: 這座位於沿海的煉油廠處理由三座海上鑽油平台運來的原油。

examples.en: Two large-scale refineries along the canal were shut down for emergency maintenance last Tuesday.

translations.zh-TW: 運河沿線的兩座大型煉油廠上週二因緊急維修而停工。

examples.en: Workers at the refinery must wear flame-resistant coveralls and pass a daily safety check.

translations.zh-TW: 煉油廠的工人必須穿著防火連身工作服，並通過每日安全檢查。

translations.definition: v. 刷新、更新、使恢復精神

examples.en: Please refresh the dashboard to load the latest inventory figures from the warehouse.

translations.zh-TW: 請重新整理儀表板，以載入倉庫最新的庫存數據。

examples.en: The intern refreshed the slide deck with charts pulled from last week's sales report.

translations.zh-TW: 實習生用上週業務報告裡的圖表更新了簡報內容。

examples.en: A short walk around the campus is refreshing before returning to a long spreadsheet audit.

translations.zh-TW: 在漫長的試算表稽核之前，繞校園散步一會兒讓人精神為之一振。

translations.definition: adj. 可退款的、可退還的

examples.en: The organizing fee is refundable only if you cancel at least fourteen days before the workshop.

translations.zh-TW: 報名費只有在工作坊開始前至少十四天取消才能退款。

examples.en: Economy tickets are less refundable than business class on most full-service carriers.

translations.zh-TW: 在大多數全服務航空中，經濟艙機票比商務艙更難辦理退票。

examples.en: Train your frontline staff so that every refundable deposit is repaid within five business days.

translations.zh-TW: 請訓練第一線員工，讓每一筆可退還的訂金都在五個工作天內退還。

translations.definition: n. 報銷、償還、墊付款退還

examples.en: Submit travel receipts to accounting within thirty days to receive reimbursement.

translations.zh-TW: 請於三十天內將差旅收據交至會計部門以辦理報銷。

examples.en: Late reimbursements frustrate consultants who front hotel and airfare on behalf of clients.

translations.zh-TW: 延遲的報銷讓那些替客戶先墊付飯店與機票費用的顧問感到挫敗。

examples.en: In the new app, a reimbursement request flows through three layers of approval before payout.

translations.zh-TW: 在新應用程式中，一筆報銷申請要經過三層審核才會撥款。

translations.definition: n. 可靠性、可信度、穩定度

examples.en: The vendor's high defect rate contradicted the reliability claims in its tender proposal.

translations.zh-TW: 供應商偏高的不良率與其標案中所宣稱的可靠度相互矛盾。

examples.en: Engineers tested the server farm under peak load to compare the reliabilities of two cloud platforms.

translations.zh-TW: 工程師在尖峰負載下測試伺服器機房，以比較兩個雲端平台的可靠度。

examples.en: Reliability is a key metric in the supplier scorecard, weighted just below on-time delivery.

translations.zh-TW: 可靠性是供應商記分卡的關鍵指標，權重僅次於準時交貨。

translations.definition: adj. 不情願的、勉強的、遲疑的

examples.en: The board was reluctant to approve the merger until the auditors released a clean report.

translations.zh-TW: 董事會遲遲不願批准這項併購，直到稽核人員發布了乾淨的報告。

examples.en: Senior staff grew more reluctant to relocate as their children approached high-school age.

translations.zh-TW: 隨著子女接近高中年紀，資深員工對於調任外地越來越不情願。

examples.en: Even after a generous counter-offer, she remained the most reluctant of the three candidates to switch employers.

translations.zh-TW: 即便收到優渥的反向挖角條件，她仍舊是三位候選人中最不願跳槽的那一位。
